# Billy Kulpa

> Creative leader who came up through code. Senior Manager, Creative at the
> Fabricators and Manufacturers Association (FMA), directing brand systems for
> a national trade association: strategy, identity, templates, and the code
> that ships them. Twenty-plus years across design, development, and
> journalism. Based in Roscoe, Illinois; works remotely. Open to
> creative-director-level roles.

This file is a plain-language summary of billykulpa.com for machine readers,
in the spirit of llms.txt. Everything here is stated on the site itself.

## Current role

- Senior Manager, Creative, Fabricators and Manufacturers Association
  (Elgin, Illinois), November 2023 to present. Owns creative output for FMA
  and its family of brands: The Fabricator, SparkForce, and a calendar of
  event subbrands. Leads a three-person creative team closing roughly 500
  design tickets a year.
- Built the design system and governance behind an email program of roughly
  2,000,000 sends a year: a 20-plus-template library, staff training, and
  compliance rules (licensing, branding, CASL/GDPR).
- Previously Senior User Interface Developer at FMA (2018-2023): redesigned
  thefabricator.com, fmamfg.org, and fabtechexpo.com in PHP, JavaScript,
  WordPress, Laravel, and Vue.js.

## Background

- Senior Manager, Creative Assets at Cleo (2013-2018): rebuilt the corporate
  identity and website of a B2B integration-software company.
- Deputy Design Director at Lee Enterprises (2012-2013): led a 30-designer
  centralized design hub producing branded publications across markets.
- Earlier: Rosecrance, GateHouse Media, and the Rockford Register Star.
  Ex-journalist; Poynter Institute Summer Visual Fellow (2007); B.A. in
  Journalism, Northern Illinois University.
- President of the board, The Superhero Center for Autism (2021-2023).

## Side projects (built solo, hands on keyboard)

- [Restreak](https://restreak.com): daily sports trivia game. Product design,
  brand, and engineering by one person in PHP, MySQL, and vanilla JavaScript,
  with a public changelog.
- This site: hand-built PHP and vanilla JS, custom CMS, GitHub Actions
  deploys, public repo at https://github.com/billykulpa/billykulpa.

## Case studies

- [Email Design at Scale](https://billykulpa.com/work/fma-email): the
  2M-send email program, template system, and governance.
- [FMA Social Brand Management](https://billykulpa.com/work/fma-social):
  one parent brand, two overlapping subbrands, constant cadence.
- [Restreak](https://billykulpa.com/work/restreak): shipping a consumer
  product solo, AI-assisted.
- [Jude's Reading Quest](https://billykulpa.com/work/judes-reading-quest):
  a reading app built for an audience of one kid.
- [Supporting Local Music](https://billykulpa.com/work/supporting-local-music):
  posters and packaging from the Rockford music scene.
